text: there’s beauty in mispelling, misunderstanding, mispronouncing, you get the idea. AI has made me forget that the imperfections of life are what make it a human experience
the quality of your life is directly proportional to the level of uncertainty you can handle
today is another chance to get up and do the thing

be a lover, be a hater, whatever 

be passionate

we default to agree with the person in front of us

consciously step back and let your thoughts be uncompromising 

the continuous development of society hinges on those of us who can muster the courage to be the black sheep
have to remind myself that the past is history and the future is a mystery…..the present is the only truth

persevere, push through, keep going                                              words are meaningless, they aren’t in your shoes, they don’t know what it’s like                                                                                 but what if you stepped back and realised it could be so simple?
set a 5 minute timer and go; repeat until you feel like your fear of starting has dissolved
just start and watch your fear self-destruct
the fastest way to understand a topic is to ask “stupid” questions until you’re no longer confused
don’t put boundaries between yourself and common sense lol
everything is malleable - believing that you can change it is the first step to leaving a dent in the world
